messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-15 09:02 UTC - High rate of 502/503 from Okta introspect in us-east-1. Affects token verification and user logins. Paging: @maya, @aj. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/auth-introspect

maya (sre-oncall): On it. Investigating logs.

maya (sre-oncall): TL;DR — hitting Okta 502s, fanout from our token-verifier service causing cascading failures. Users failing to login and console access errors ~12% of requests. Escalating.

aj (eng-auth): Looking. Can you post curl from one of failing host?

maya (sre-oncall): logs: ```ERROR introspect.go:142: introspect failed status=502 body="Bad Gateway" host=login.okta.com``` 

maya (sre-oncall): curl example: ```curl -i -X POST https://login.okta.com/oauth2/v1/introspect -d 'token=...'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
``` 

lena (support-lead): Support: getting customer reports, many orgs can't login. Are we masking this? Need customer impact estimate.

sam (product): Product: estimate users impacted? Any payment/enterprise customers affected?

maya (sre-oncall): From metrics: ~8-14% auth failures globally, spike in eu-west after 09:00, major consoles affected for some power users. No billing impact yet. Listing top 10 orgs in DM to support.

aj (eng-auth): Mitigation plan: 1) throttle our introspect fanout 2) increase JWKS cache TTL to 1h 3) enable local signature verification fallback for tokens with kid we have cached 4) reduce retry aggressiveness. Deploying patch to token-verifier.

deploy-bot: [deploy] token-verifier v2.13.7 -> production in progress (canary 2 hosts)

maya (sre-oncall): Rolling canary, watching error rate.

aj (eng-auth): Config snippet applied: ```auth.token_verifier:
  introspect_max_parallel: 50
  jwks_cache_ttl: 3600
  retry_backoff_ms: 5000
  fallback_local_verify: true
``` 

maya (sre-oncall): After canary: error-rate down from 12% -> 4% on canary hosts. Promoting.

deploy-bot: rollout 25% -> 100% complete. No rollback.

okta-status-bot: Okta Status: Partial Outage - OAuth2 Introspect: We are investigating increased error rates in us-east-1. https://status.okta.com/incident/abc123

aj (eng-auth): Contacted Okta support via SOC ticket and sent logs + time window. Ticket # OKTA-78901.

lena (support-lead): Notifying top 5 affected customers via templates. Draft pasted: "We're investigating an external identity provider incident causing login failures..." 

sam (product): Also add note to status.redwood.com pointing to Okta status and our mitigations.

maya (sre-oncall): Postmortem notes for now: root cause external, mitigation=bias toward local verification + throttle. Next steps: improve JWKS priming, add per-org retry budget, and set up automated fallback to cached introspect responses for heavy orgs.

ops-pager: Handing off to night oncall @jordan. Please summarize actions and what to monitor in incident doc.

maya (sre-oncall): Summary posted in incident doc: https://internal/incidents/2851234567. Looping Jordan in DM. Closing thread here, will reopen if errors >5% for >15m.
